export type PublicMenu={id:string;label:string;eyebrow:string;title:string;description:string;feature:{label:string;href:string};groups:{label:string;items:NavItem[]}[]};
const link=(id:string,label:string,description:string,href:string):NavItem=>({id,label,description,href});

export const navigationMatches=(item:NavItem,q:string)=>!q.trim()||(item.label+' '+item.description).toLocaleLowerCase('id-ID').includes(q.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('id-ID'));
